page_title: BET 1-1 GIR | Betis v Girona 21/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends a chip pass into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga is quickest to intercept the ball.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90' Portu (Girona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
88' 1 - 1 German Pezzella (Betis) is in the right place at the right time and perfectly hits a rebound into the top left corner.
88' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

88' Borja Iglesias (Betis) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance. The ball goes behind for a corner. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
88' Betis are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
85' A quickly taken corner by Betis.
85' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Betis.
82' Aleix Garcia (Girona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
80' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
79' Here is a change. Yan Couto is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Valery (Girona).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Savio departs the field of play to be replaced by Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
79' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Miguel Gutierrez (Girona). The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Girona.

78' A through ball from William Carvalho (Betis) fails to reach Abde Ezzalzouli as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Abde Ezzalzouli could have got into a promising position. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
76' Unbelievable miss! Aitor Ruibal (Betis) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
75' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends the corner into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts it and averts the threat.
75' Assane Diao (Betis) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Betis will take a corner kick.
73' Betis control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
69' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
66' The manager makes a subsitution with Sergi Altimira (Betis) coming on for Marc Roca.
66' Substitution. Rodri makes way for Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis).
66' It will be a substitution. Borja Iglesias (Betis) is ready to enter the pitch as Willian Jose walks off.
65' Michel has decided to substitute Pablo Torre and he is replaced by Portu (Girona).
64' The substitution has been made. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) has replaced Artem Dovbyk.
61' Assane Diao (Betis) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
60' 43:57 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
57' Willian Jose (Betis) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
56' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle as Chadi Riad (Betis) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
54' Savio (Girona) gets on the end of a pass from Artem Dovbyk inside the box and quickly shoots, but the effort goes inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
53' Marc Roca (Betis) takes the corner but it's cleared.
53' Ayoze Perez (Betis) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Betis will take a corner.
52' The corner kick from Aleix Garcia (Girona) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
51' A pass into the penalty area from Pablo Torre (Girona) is intercepted by the defence. Girona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

50' William Carvalho (Betis) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the middle of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
49' Aleix Garcia (Girona) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
48' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.

46' What a big chance! Artem Dovbyk (Girona) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
46' Manuel Pellegrini makes a switch. William Carvalho (Betis) is coming on in place of Andres Guardado at the start of the second period.
46' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea shows a yellow card to Marc Roca (Betis) for his blatant foul.
45+3' What was Andres Guardado (Betis) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45+2' Rodri (Betis) tries a shot from distance, but the goalkeeper can stay calm as it goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Andres Guardado (Betis) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
44' Betis are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. Betis force a corner. They send men into the box.
43' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
43' Marc Roca (Betis) meets a cross inside the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
42' Andres Guardado (Betis) takes the corner which is cleared.
42' Assane Diao (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Betis are awarded a corner kick.
39' 0 - 1 Goal! Artem Dovbyk (Girona) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Rui Silva to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
39' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is going to take the penalty!

38' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Girona are about to take a penalty!
34' Michel is forced to make a change. David Lopez is unable to continue due to injury, Juanpe (Girona) comes on.
33' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
32' David Lopez (Girona) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
31' Rodri (Betis) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. Betis get a corner.
29' Savio (Girona) whips the ball into the box and Artem Dovbyk takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
27' Ayoze Perez (Betis) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the bottom right corner, but is denied by a reflex save from Paulo Gazzaniga.
26' Willian Jose (Betis) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Paulo Gazzaniga stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.

25' Assane Diao (Betis) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
24' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Artem Dovbyk, but Rui Silva displays great awareness to stop him.
23' Savio (Girona) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and releases a quick shot to the bottom left corner. His promising effort is kept out by Rui Silva, who pulls off a stunning save!
22' Aleix Garcia (Girona) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
22' Yan Couto (Girona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Girona have a corner.

21' Ayoze Perez (Betis) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies just over the crossbar, almost brushing it. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
20' Willian Jose (Betis) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
19' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is flagged for offside.
15' Hector Bellerin is substituted due to injury. Manuel Pellegrini gives a chance to Aitor Ruibal (Betis).
15' It doesn’t look good for Hector Bellerin (Betis); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
13' Savio (Girona) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
13' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Savio (Girona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
10' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
10' Yan Couto (Girona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
8' Hector Bellerin (Betis) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
7' Hector Bellerin (Betis) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
6' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
5' Girona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
1' Yan Couto (Girona) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Betis will take the kick-off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea will referee today's match.
